question.text: Two open beakers one containing a solvent and the other containing a mixture of that solvent with a non volatile solute are together sealed in a container. Over time:

options.text: the volume of the solution increases and the volume of the solvent decreases
the volume of the solution decreases and the volume of the solvent increases
the volume of the solution and the solvent does not change the volume of the solution does not
change and the volume of the solvent decreases

solution.text: Two open beakers one containing a solvent and the other containing a mixture of that solvent with a non volatile solute are together sealed in a container, the volume of the solution increases and the volume of the solvent decreases.
